sources.title: Inkling Small NVFP4 — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: Inkling Small NVFP4 is a compact, open-weight multimodal model that accepts both text and image inputs. The NVFP4 format suggests it's optimized for efficient inference on NVIDIA hardware using low-precision quantization, trading some numerical precision for speed and reduced memory footprint.

sources.title: Inkling-Small-NVFP4 on a Dual DGX Spark Cluster
sources.snippet: Inkling-Small-NVFP4, a 276B-parameter MoE model with 12B active parameters, has just been released. It is a native multimodal model with vision/audio support and a context window of up to 1 million tokens.
